✅ Basic Terminal/Command Prompt Awareness (Helpful)

Knowing how to open and use the terminal is helpful, but we guide you through Git commands step by step.

✅ Willingness to Practice

Git is learned by doing. You should be ready to practice alongside the lessons.

❌ What You Don’t Need

  • No prior Git/GitHub knowledge
  • No company experience
  • No advanced coding skills
